research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Eyenk.com is engaged in the development of systems and methods for automated end-to-end eye screening. This involves a fully automated system that includes an eye imaging device, a movement mechanism, a computing platform for guidance, a user interface, and an electronic display. These innovations aim to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of eye screening processes. Eyenk.com is focusing on advancing eye screening technology to improve user experience and diagnostic capabilities.
